products.description:
Create a grand festive entrance with the Festive Feeling 7ft Tree Arch. Designed to transform doorways, hallways, and indoor spaces into a magical Christmas display, this stunning decorative arch features lush greenery and an elegant seasonal look that instantly adds warmth and festive charm to your home.

Standing approximately 2.1 metres tall, the arch is crafted with an impressive 7904 branch tips for a full and realistic appearance. The sturdy foldable metal stand provides reliable support while allowing for convenient storage after the festive season. Perfect for creating a statement entrance or framing your holiday décor, this tree arch brings a luxurious Christmas feel to any space.

Ideal for indoor use, the Festive Feeling Tree Arch is the perfect addition for homes, events, and festive displays.

products.displayName: Prestige Mains Operated 200 LED Pine Cone String Light
products.description:
Add a warm, festive glow to your home or garden with these beautifully designed Prestige 200 LED Pine Cone String Lights. Featuring delicately textured pine cone-style bulbs, these lights create a soft, sparkling effect that enhances any Christmas display.

With 200 bright LEDs, you’ll enjoy excellent coverage—perfect for decorating Christmas trees, wrapping around banisters, or illuminating outdoor spaces. Choose between warm white for a classic, cosy ambiance or multi-colour for a vibrant, playful look.

Designed for convenience, these lights include 8 different lighting sequences, allowing you to customise your display from gentle twinkling to dynamic flashing effects. The built-in timer function (typically 6 hours on / 18 hours off) makes everyday use effortless, while the memory function remembers your last selected setting.

Powered by mains electricity, they provide reliable, long-lasting brightness and are suitable for both indoor and outdoor use (with the adaptor kept dry). The generous 24.9m lead wire gives you flexibility to decorate larger areas with ease.
products.smallDescription: Light up your space with the Prestige Pine Cone String Light, featuring 200 bright LEDs and 8 dazzling sequences. Perfect for indoor and outdoor use, it’s mains operated with handy timer and memory functions.

products.description:
Bring timeless festive elegance to your home with the Festive Feeling 60cm Hydrangea Christmas Wreath—a beautifully crafted statement piece designed to transform your front door into a warm holiday welcome.

This luxurious wreath features rich, deep red hydrangea blooms paired with clusters of glossy red berries, creating a classic Christmas colour palette. Lush evergreen foliage, including pine and eucalyptus-style leaves, adds natural texture and depth, while delicate sprigs and layered greenery give it a full, premium look.

At 60cm in diameter, it offers an impressive presence—perfect for doors, walls, or above a mantel. The balanced arrangement ensures it looks stunning from every angle, making it an ideal centrepiece for both indoor and sheltered outdoor display.
